method: Separate post-draft self-review against source, recorded outputs and independent scientific/data reviews.
score_reason: Concrete controls, quantities and limits; technical structure is appropriate to this genre. Some protocol/checklist phrasing remains.
confidence_reason: Subjective editorial self-judgment; no calibrated authorship detector or human-style validation.

examples.quote: Private research driver uses the existing matched-founder initializer and
examples.impact: Names the reused path and the controlled factors concretely.

science_gate_reason: Design, estimators, ploidy/viability controls, paired units, importance margin and interpretation match the implemented study; biological validity remains explicitly outside scope.
facts_gate_reason: Numbers, commands and source identity checked against recorded CSVs, timings, receipts and current files; findings received a separate scientific review.
references_gate_reason: No external literature references; local source and evidence paths are present in the repository.
calibration_status: Read protocol calibration summary; no held-out style controls used.
